items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In the rhythm is the rhythm section you saw last night: Danny Mixon, Dave Gibson, and Gerald Cannon... That’s it. We have a couple of vocalists... That’s just another one of those things. This society -­ we fail to recognize some of our greater talents. That’s it. That’s the Loud Minority family.

ctx.x: You had a pretty interesting drummer last night.
I’d only heard him in a big band setting. Didn’t know that he played like that.
